description: The last building on Foundry Way before the grass: a long, low glasshouse, a third of it reglazed in mismatched panes and patched with bare board. Compost bags under a tarpaulin against the end wall. A hand-painted board reads COMPOST MENTIS, and under it, EVERYTHING HERE WILL GROW IN THIS SOIL, WE HAVE CHECKED.
name: Compost Mentis
